theorem: Ordinary torsion of a finite based complex with rational local Euler-variable entries is rational in that variable.
obstruction: exp(plus or minus x^2/2) is not rational: logarithmic differentiation gives a polynomial identity whose right degree exceeds the left degree by two.
consequence: The finite two-periodic C2 norm complex can type the second-Adams anomaly but cannot reproduce its exact quadratic Euler exponential by ordinary torsion.
required_enlargement: infinite heat- or zeta-regularized relative torsion
status: universal finite-torsion no-go; infinite analytic construction open
